_comment: Project registry template. Copy to projects.json (gitignored) — the backend also creates/updates it for you as you add projects in the UI. Keys are short project ids; each maps to a display name and the folder under backend/tasks/ that holds its task markdown. Add "archived": true (+ "archived_at": <ISO>) to soft-retire a project. The implicit "Root" project (tasks with no folder) renders as "Unassigned" and needs no entry here.
